scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @spikive/server" "npm run dev -w @spikive/web"
scripts.build: npm run clean && npm run build -w @spikive/shared && npm run build -w @spikive/web && npm run build -w @spikive/server
scripts.test: npm run test -w @spikive/shared && npm run test -w @spikive/server && npm run test -w @spikive/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @spikive/shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.verify: npm run check:rendering-architecture && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build && npm audit --omit=dev
